If the Attribute reaches 0, the victim's soul or life force is devoured by the attacker and the victim dies. Alternative Damage requires the monstrous trait Spirit Form.
novice: I [Pas] Deal 3 dmg to Attrib (ign. Armor).
adept: II [Pas] Deal 4 dmg to Attrib.
master: III [Pas] Deal 5 dmg to Attrib.

name: Armored
description: The creature either has thick skin, scales or something else making it especially hard to wound. It cannot wear any additional armor over its natural armor, which, on the other hand, is not Impeding like ordinary armor is. However, the Man-at-arms ability enhances the creature's protection even further, in addition to its level in Armored.
novice: I [Pas] Natural Armor 2.
adept: II [Pas] Natural Armor 3.
master: III [Pas] Natural Armor 4.

name: Corrupting attack
description: Those of Davokar's creatures that are most corrupted have the ability to spread the dark taint through their claws and other natural weapons.
novice: I [Pas] Deal 1D4 Temp Corr on dmg.
adept: II [Pas] Deal 1D6 Temp Corr.
master: III [Pas] Deal 1D8 Temp Corr.

name: Enthrall
description: The creature can hypnotize its victims and make them unable to act until it is too late.
novice: I [Act] [Res←Res] or lose 2 actions.
adept: II [Act] Area (sound). Lose 2 actions.
master: III [Act] Sustained until [Res←Res] pass or dmg taken.

name: Gravely cold
description: Wherever it moves, the creature spreads the cold of the grave around itself like an aura, and everyone in its immediate vicinity is at risk of being affected.
novice: I [Free] Paralyze nearby [Res]. 1 test/turn. Immune after success.
adept: II [Free] +2 dmg/turn (ign. Armor).
master: III [Free] Paralyze check [Res←Res].

name: Manifestation
description: The creature has disciplined its Spirit Form to the point where it can manifest itself physically for a shorter or longer period of time.
novice: I [Free] Physical 1 turn. Natural weapons only.
adept: II [Free] Physical indefinitely. Use gear.
master: III [Spec] Physical actions while remaining immaterial (immune to non-magic).

name: Natural weapon
description: The creature is gifted with a well-developed natural weapon, such as sharp claws, teeth or a tail stinger. The Natural Warrior ability (see page 119) can be used to enhance the creature's Natural Weapon even further.
novice: I [Pas] 3 dmg.
adept: II [Pas] 4 dmg.
master: III [Pas] 5 dmg. Long quality.

name: Poisonous
description: The creature's unarmed attack or Natural Weapon is poisonous and each hit that wounds an enemy will also poison it, unless the victim succeeds with a [Strong←Cunning] test. The poison's effect can be cancelled if someone applies an antidote to the wound and succeeds with a Cunning test.
novice: I [Pas] [Str←Cun] or 2 dmg/2 turns.
adept: II [Pas] 3 dmg/3 turns.
master: III [Pas] 4 dmg/4 turns.

name: Poison spit
description: The creature is not just Poisonous; it can also spit venom at its enemies. The poison attack is performed just like an ordinary ranged attack; if hit the victim must pass a [Strong←Cunning] test to avoid being posioned. The venomous spit counts as a ranged attack. The poison's effect can be cancelled if someone applies an antidote and succeeds with a Cunning test. Poison Spit requires that the creature has the Poisonous trait at the same level or higher.
novice: I [Act] Ranged. [Str←Cun] or 2 dmg/2 turns.
adept: II [Act] 3 dmg/3 turns.
master: III [Act] 4 dmg/4 turns.

name: Regeneration
description: The creature spontaneously heals, without needing to spend either time or power to do so. However, the creature has a weakness, a specific type of damage that it cannot regenerate (which, of course, can be healed in other active ways). The creature must choose a weakness related to some kind of damage it cannot heal automatically. Choose between magical weapons, elemental energies (fire or acid) and damage from either holy or unholy attacks.
novice: I [Pas] Heal 2 [Tgh]/turn. Choose weakness.
adept: II [Pas] Heal 3 [Tgh]/turn.
master: III [Pas] Heal 4 [Tgh]/turn.

name: Robust (bis)
description: The creature is bigger and tougher than usual, and can only wear modified light armor.
novice: I [Pas] Ignore 2 dmg/hit. +2 melee dmg (1/turn). Def [Qui-2].
adept: II [Pas] Ignore 3 dmg/hit. +3 melee dmg (1/turn). Def [Qui-3].
master: III [Pas] Ignore 4 dmg/hit. +4 melee dmg (1/turn). Def [Qui-4].

name: Spirit form
description: The creature is a spirit; it is immaterial and can neither affect nor be affected by physical effects. A spirit whose Toughness is brought down to 0 is banished from the area for a shorter or longer period of time. Spirit Form gives access to the Alternative Damage, Manifestation and Terrify monstrous traits.
novice: I [Pas] Half dmg from weapons. Full from magic/alchemy. Pass barriers (not water).
adept: II [Pas] Half dmg from all except magic ignoring armor.
master: III [Pas] Immune to physical. Half dmg from magic.

name: Swarm
description: The creature is a collective, its mind spread among a swarm of bodies. The creature cannot be destroyed unless the entire swarm is obliterated.
novice: I [Spec] Half dmg. Flee at 50% [Tgh]. Mental atk hits whole swarm.
adept: II [Spec] Flee if dmg > Pain Threshold. 2 chances vs mental.
master: III [Spec] Quarter dmg. Fearless.

name: Terrify
description: The creature can strike terror into the heart of one or more creatures. Terrify requires that the creature has the monstrous trait Spirit Form.
novice: I [Act] [Res←Res] or flee/cower.
adept: II [Act] Area (sound). Flee/cower.
master: III [Free] Area. Flee/cower (no defense).

name: Undead
description: The creature is a spirit trapped inside a dead body. The spirit controls the slowly decaying corpse and is banished when the body is destroyed.
novice: I [Pas] No Pain Threshold. No heal. Eat meat/blood (1 consumed = 2 [Tgh]).
adept: II [Pas] Half dmg physical/elements. Full magic (ign armor).
master: III [Pas] Half dmg alchemy/magic. Full magical weapons/holy.

name: Web
description: The creature can spin tough webs and use them either passively or actively to capture its prey.
novice: I [Pas] Pass [Qui←Cun] or stuck. Break [Str←Cun].
adept: II [Act] Throw net [Quick←Acc]. Stuck target.
master: III [Act] Net attacks independently (3 threads).

name: Wings
description: The creature is equipped with wings of some kind (either bird or insect-like) and has a more or less developed ability to fly.
novice: I [Pas] Fly move (no Free Atk).
adept: II [Pas] Hover.
master: III [Pas] Sweep attack (Move-Atk-Move).

name: Amphibian
description: The creature is built for a life in and out of water, and can extract oxygen from both water and air. The creature has no negative effects from fighting in water and does not suffer damage from doing so (see Combat in Water to the right).
novice: [Pas] Breathe water/air. No penalty in water.

name: Avenging Successor
description: The one who kills a creature with this trait is immediately exposed to its vengeance, in the form of one or more other creatures. The type of avenger depends on the creature with the trait; the level of the trait only defines how many and how dangerous the avenging creatures are, not their exact nature. Normally, the avenging creatures are of the same breed as the being who has the trait, but this is not a requirement as long as the combination makes sense. The only restriction is that only thoroughly corrupt creatures can have other thoroughly corrupted beasts as avengers. Note that a creature needs to be of at least Challenging resistance to be able to have the trait Avenging Successor.
novice: I [Rea] On death, spawn 1 avenger (2 levels lower).
adept: II [Rea] Spawn 2 avengers.
master: III [Rea] Spawn 3 avengers.

name: Bloodlust
description: The creature thirsts for warm blood, and with its gaze it can put its victim into a trance before feasting on its life-giving juices.
novice: I [Act] Charm [Res←Res] & Bite. Drain 2 [Tgh]/turn (ign Armor). Sustained [Res←Res] or Dmg.
adept: II [Act] Heal equal to drain.
master: III [Act] Drain 3 [Tgh]. Victim cannot break trance.

name: Carapace
description: Under special circumstances, the natural armor of the creature gives it the option to double its armor value – when and to what extent is decided by the level of the trait. Note that a creature needs to have at least level I in Armored to have the trait Carapace.
novice: I [Pas] Hunker (no action): Double Armor.
adept: II [Pas] Double Armor moving/free attacks.
master: III [Rea] Hit? Roll 2nd chance to miss (Double Armor).

name: Collective Power
description: The collective gains mystical powers when enough members are gathered closely together; the more members, the mightier their collective power, up to a certain limit (see Table 6 on page 166). The collective can perform one mystical power per turn, in addition to the actions of its individual members. If differences exist, this action is activated on the highest individual initiative of the collective. The power works as usual, but its collective origin makes it harder for the enemy to break the concentration of the caster – three of the collective's members has to lose concentration during the same turn for it to have an effect on the ongoing power.
novice: [Spec] Group casts 1 power/turn. Harder to break conc.

name: Colossal
description: There are creatures that grow to such immense proportions that their sheer size gives them the upper hand, albeit at the cost of a notable slowness in movements and reflexes. Surviving a combat encounter with such a monstrosity calls for as much luck as proficiency and, when it comes to the most massive beasts, also weapons with extraordinary qualities. Colossal requires the creature to have level III in the trait Robust.
novice: I [Pas] Atk takes 2 actions. Roll Dmg twice (take low) vs target armor.
adept: II [Pas] No Reaction while moving. Target rolls Def twice (take low).
master: III [Pas] Immune to non-magical wpns.

name: Companions
description: The creature is never alone, never encountered without its companions in tow. The trait does not decide who the companions are, only how many and how strong they are. The companions may be the creature's offspring, loyal servants or whatever seems suitable. Note that a creature needs to be of at least Challenging resistance to be able to have the trait Companions.
novice: I [Pas] 1 companion (2 levels lower).
adept: II [Pas] 2 companions.
master: III [Pas] 3 companions.

name: Corruption Hoarder
description: The creature is able to accumulate corruption and use it for a series of special actions. The corruption hoarder may at most accumulate Resolute/2 (rounded up) points of corruption for use in this way. Collected corruption dissipates at a rate of one point per day; a corruption hoarder depleted of accumulated corruption is driven by a deep hunger for more. Only thoroughly corrupt creatures can have the trait Corruption Hoarder.
novice: I [Act] Steal 2 Corr/turn (deal 4 dmg). [Rea] Spend Corr: Force enemy re-roll.
adept: II [Pas] Atk drains 2 Corr. [Rea] Spend 2 Corr.
master: III [Pas] [Rea] Spend unlimited Corr.

name: Corruption Sensitive
description: The creature is blessed with a sensory organ through which it can detect nearby outbreaks of corruption. This ability most likely emerged as a warning system, but many witch hunters would probably give their left eye for the advantage such a sense would confer in the hunt for heretics and cultists.
novice: I [Rea] [Vig] detect Corr (500m).
adept: II [Rea] Pinpoint location.
master: III [Rea] Track source (1 day).

name: Crushing Embrace
description: The creature's natural weapons allow it to grip, hold on to and crush its enemies.
novice: I [Rea] On dmg, grapple [Quick←Acc]. Break [Str←Str]. 2 dmg/turn (ign Armor).
adept: II [Rea] 3 dmg/turn.
master: III [Rea] 4 dmg/turn.

name: Deadly Breath
description: The creature has the ability to spew forth a harmful cascade, so powerful that it can obliterate enemies or at least damage them severely. The breath can consist of fire, cold, acid or lightning. Together with the trait Alternative Damage the cascade affects the chosen Attribute instead of Toughness, but only if the creature has Alternative Damage to at least the same level as Deadly Breath. The cascade can also be corrupting or poisonous instead, if the creature has the traits Corrupting Attack or Poisonous to the same level or higher.
novice: I [Act] 1 target [Quick←Acc]. Fail: 6 dmg. Success: 3 dmg.
adept: II [Act] Chain on fail.
master: III [Act] Chain on success too. 2nd success breaks chain.

name: Death Struggle
description: When the creature dies, its accumulated wrath is unleashed in attacks against those unlucky enough to be within reach. From level II, the Death Struggle attacks count as normal combat actions and can make use of active abilities, powers and traits.
novice: I [Rea] On death, Free Atk.
adept: II [Rea] Full Combat Action.
master: III [Rea] Attack up to 5 enemies.

name: Devour
description: The creature can swallow enemies and have them perish in its belly. Normally, only one victim at a time may be swallowed, but if the creature so wishes, it can use a free action to spew out a victim in order to make room for a new one. Devour requires that the creature has level I or higher in the trait Colossal. The level in Colossal also determines how many victims may be simultaneously swallowed: three at level II, and a total of six at level III.
novice: I [Act] Dmg -> Retain. Next turn Swallow [Str←Str]. Belly: 2 dmg/turn (ign Armor).
adept: II [Act] Hit -> Retain.
master: III [Rea] Hit -> Swallow immediately.

name: Diminutive
description: The creature is so small, slender and pitiful that it arouses sympathy even in enemies. In short, it is difficult to see it as a credible threat, even when it is armed. The effect of this is that enemies tend to choose other targets first; they must pass a [Resolute←Discreet] test to bring themselves to attack. The only exceptions are if the diminutive creature is the only possible target or if it shows that it actually can fight (that is, if it manages to deal damage to an enemy). Diminutive is immediately thwarted if the creature makes use of any Ability or Power, or of some other trait.
novice: [Pas] Enemies test [Res←Dis] to attack creature (unless alone/hostile).

name: Free Spirit
description: The creature's spirit is detached from the fate of the world, and it is therefore immune to all forms of corruption. As a side effect, the creature cannot learn any mystical powers or rituals. However, it can use mystical artifacts without suffering from any corruption that might occur.
novice: [Pas] Immune to Corr. Cannot learn powers/rituals (artifacts ok).

name: Grappling Tongue
description: The creature has a long tongue which can be used to attack and grapple targets which are within two movement actions away. The attack counts and deals damage as a bite, and if the target has at least one level lower than the creature in the trait Robust, the creature may try to pull the target into melee range. The target rolls a [Strong←Strong] test; if it fails, the target is pulled towards the creature which then can combine Grappling Tongue with other traits, such as Devour and Crushing Embrace.
novice: [Spec] Ranged grapple (2 moves). Pull [Str←Strong].

name: Harmful Aura
description: The creature exudes harmful energies that each turn deal damage to everyone within melee range. Also, the creature leaves clear marks in its wake, in the form of a burnt, frozen or otherwise warped trail through the environment. Hence, all attempts to track the creature automatically succeed. The aura can consist of fire, cold, acid or lightning. Together with the trait Alternative Damage the aura affects the chosen Attribute instead of Toughness, but only if the creature has Alternative Damage to at least the same level as Harmful Aura. The aura can also be corrupting or poisonous instead, if the creature has the traits Corrupting Attack or Poisonous to the same level or higher.
novice: I [Pas] 2 dmg/turn (ign Armor) in melee.
adept: II [Pas] 3 dmg/turn.
master: III [Pas] 4 dmg/turn.

name: Haunting
description: The creature can invade the body of other beings, as if using the ritual Possess (see page 145 in the Core Rulebook), but without it taking as long. At higher levels, the possession is even reactive, aimed at the enemy who slays the creature. Haunting requires at least level I in the trait Spirit Form.
novice: I [Rea] Touch/Dmg possess [Res←Res]. Tests daily/weekly/monthly for perm.
adept: II [Rea] On death/0 Tgh, possess killer.
master: III [Rea] Possession auto-permanent.

name: Infectious
description: The creature carries a contagious disease and those harmed by its natural weapons are at risk of being infected. The higher the level of the trait, the worse the disease.
novice: I [Rea] Dmg causes [Str] test vs Weak disease.
adept: II [Rea] Moderate disease.
master: III [Rea] Strong disease.

name: Infestation
description: Some parasitical creatures have the capacity to penetrate the body of a victim, or with claws or stinger plant larvae inside an unwilling host. The impact of the parasite depends on the particular creature, while this trait decides how difficult it is to avoid being, or staying, infested.
novice: I [Rea] Dmg -> Penetrate (1 turn). Remove: 1D8 dmg (1D4 w/ Cun). Medicus: 1D10 dmg.
adept: II [Rea] Penetrate immediately. Medicus: 1D12 dmg.
master: III [Rea] Medicus: 1D20 dmg.

name: Invisibility
description: The creature can make itself invisible. Enemies can still use other senses besides sight to locate it. The creature makes sounds and leaves tracks, and it can be made partially visible by creatively using dust, sand, flour or similar means. Some elixirs, such as Ghost Candles (see page 153 in the Core Rulebook), counteract this trait, just as the mystical power True Form can make the creature observable.
novice: I [Act] Invisible. Area/expose req [Vig←Dis].
adept: II [Act] Expose lasts 1 turn.
master: III [Free] Invisible default. Expose 1 turn.

name: Life Sense
description: The creature has a supernatural sense which lets it perceive living beings (all but undead spirits). This makes the creature difficult to surprise, and at higher levels it can also be used actively to surprise others.
novice: I [Pas] Detect life through barriers [Dis←Vig].
adept: II [Pas] Attack through barriers.
master: III [Pas] Use powers through barriers.

name: Many-headed
description: The creature has multiple heads or limbs governed by separate brains/minds, and can use them independently of each other. Damage is suffered separately by each part, as if they were separate creatures, so they have to be taken out one by one. Only once all are eliminated does the creature die. A drawback is that the traits Armored and Robust are weakened at the higher levels of Many-headed: such a massive and simultaneously limber body cannot fully utilize all its protection and strength in all directions at once.
novice: I [Pas] 2 parts/actions.
adept: II [Pas] 4 parts/actions. Armored/Robust -1 level.
master: III [Pas] 8 parts/actions. Armored/Robust -2 levels.

name: Metamorphosis
description: The creature has no fixed shape, adapting its form to its surroundings and the challenges it faces. The effect lasts until the creature opts to switch traits or it is targeted by the mystical power True Form – if successful, this removes the traits provided by the Metamorphosis, until a new active action is spent on getting them back. Through the process of adapting itself, the creature can take on a form giving it characteristics that correspond to one or more of the following traits: Acidic Attack, Amphibian, Armored, Carapace, Deadly Breath, Diminutive, Grappling Tongue, Natural Weapon, Poisonous, Poison Spit, Prehensile Claws, Robust, Tunneler, Web, Wings.
novice: I [Act] Adopt 1 Trait (Level I).
adept: II [Act] 2 Traits (I) or 1 Trait (II).
master: III [Act] 2 Traits (II) or 1 Trait (III).

name: Mystical Resistance
description: The creature has a natural resistance against the effects of mystical powers. Basically, it is more difficult to harm or affect by mystical means, and on higher levels there is also a risk that the energies directed against it are reflected to hit someone else.
novice: I [Pas] Powers roll twice (must pass both).
adept: II [Pas] Fail reflects power to random target.
master: III [Pas] Reflect to chosen target.

name: Night Perception
description: The creature has been gifted with the ability to perceive its surroundings using sound waves – it emits sound pulses that bounce off nearby objects and return to the creature, which then forms a mental image of what its surroundings look like. Because of this, the creature can perceive beings and objects made invisible by powers or traits, and in other respects act as usual even in complete darkness.
novice: [Pas] Sonar. See invisible/darkness.

name: Observant
description: The physical or supernatural senses of the creature give it a perfect view in all directions. This means that the creature cannot be flanked, or rather that those flanking it do not gain Advantage against the creature.
novice: [Pas] cannot be flanked (no Advantage).

name: Paralyzing Venom
description: The creature's claws, venomous bite or stinger has a paralyzing effect. At best, the victim is dazed by the venom; at worst, it is completely incapacitated and unable to protect itself from incoming attacks. The effect remains active until someone administers an antidote to the victim and passes a Cunning test.
novice: I [Pas] Dmg -> [Str]. Pass: Dazed (2nd chance fail). Fail: Reactive only.
adept: II [Pas] Fail: Reactive only 1D4 turns.
master: III [Pas] [Str-5]. Fail: Paralyzed 1D8 turns.

name: Piercing Attack
description: The attack deals no normal damage. Instead, the damage value determines whether the attack manages to pierce the victim's Armor. If the armor value is equal to or higher than the damage value, the attack fails; if the armor value is lower, the victim suffers an effect such as poison or corruption, depending on what other traits the creature has.
novice: I [Pas] Dmg value 4. Pierce Armor or fail.
adept: II [Pas] Dmg value 5.
master: III [Pas] Dmg value 6.

name: Prehensile Claws
description: The claws of the creature deal damage like unarmed attacks, and also give it a chance to grip and hold enemies – usually with the aim of dragging them towards its grinding jaws.
novice: I [Act] 2 attacks. Both hit = Grip [Str←Str]. Next turn pull.
adept: II [Act] 1 hit = Grip.
master: III [Act] 1 hit = Pull immediately [Str←Str].

name: Rampage
description: The creature can use its body mass to crush, or at least push away, enemies in its path. The trait does not protect against Free Attacks caused by Long weapons or movements past prepared enemies. Rampage requires at least the corresponding level of the Robust trait.
novice: I [Move] Path test [Str←Str] or 2 dmg + prone. Robust adds +2/level.
adept: II [Move] 3 dmg.
master: III [Move] 4 dmg.

name: Root Wall
description: The creature can extend its root system and have it shoot up from the ground to hinder enemy movement. At higher levels, the wall can also deal damage to those trying to pass it, or even grip and hold them.
novice: I [Act] Raise wall (Tgh 10). Block move.
adept: II [Act] Near wall test [Quick←Acc] or 3 dmg.
master: III [Free] 5 dmg + Grip [Str←Str].

name: Sturdy
description: The monster possesses a remarkable vitality, possibly born out of a strong link to the forces of nature, or maybe stemming from a bottomless source of corruption. The creature's Toughness is higher than its Strong value would suggest, but its Pain Threshold is unaffected (based on Strong/2, as usual).
novice: I [Pas] Toughness = Strong x 1.5.
adept: II [Pas] Toughness = Strong x 2.
master: III [Pas] Toughness = Strong x 3.

name: Summoner
description: The creature can summon reinforcements from the Yonderworld, reinforcements which disappear upon the summoner's death or at the end of the scene. The reinforcements obey the orders of the summoner, but have to hear them being spoken or shouted – they are not controlled telepathically. Only thoroughly corrupt creatures may be summoners; all others would immediately become blight born by the abhorrent tearing in the fabric of the world.
novice: I [Act] 1/scene [Res] summon Daemon.
adept: II [Rea] When hit 1/turn [Res] summon.
master: III [Free] 1/turn [Res] summon.

name: Swift
description: The creature is lightning fast, and can do extra attacks as part of its combat action. The initial attack may be an attack in melee, at range or with mystical powers, but the extra attacks cannot involve active abilities.
novice: I [Rea] Hit -> Free Attack.
adept: II [Rea] Dmg -> 2 Free Attacks.
master: III [Rea] Attack -> 2 Free Attacks.

name: Tunneler
description: The creature moves just as easily below the ground as on the surface, provided that the terrain is made of earth, sand, mud, gravel or similar material – solid rock forces the creature around, below or to the surface. Skilled tunnelers can use the underground to avoid enemy attacks, and the best tunnelers can create sinkholes under enemies, to be used as a weapon. Even below ground, the creature has a feel for the direction and distance to known landmarks, but it cannot perceive what hides under the surface until it gets there.
novice: I [Pas] Half speed underground. Avoid Free Atk.
adept: II [Pas] Full speed. Split move/attack (pop up).
master: III [Act] Create sinkhole. [Quick] or fall (Free Atk).

name: Wrecker
description: The attacks of the creature are powerful enough to throw enemies to the ground. The mightiest of wreckers are even capable of acting as living battering rams, crushing gates, razing towers and toppling walls with their natural weapons.
novice: I [Rea] Dmg -> Knockdown [Str←Str].
adept: II [Rea] Fail = Thrown 1D6m (fall dmg).
master: III [Pas] Attacks gain Wrecking quality.

name: Paws
description: The creature has poorly developed hands, making it difficult to perform fine motor tasks such as lockpicking. Whenever a challenge requires hand dexterity, the creature has a second chance to fail.
novice: [Pas] 2nd chance to fail fine motor tasks.

name: Dead Inside
description: Certain creatures exhibit foul manifestations of pestilence and putrescence. They might necrotize flesh with a glance, command creeping horrors that bite and gnaw, or possess mutated guts that burrow through living flesh with twisted maws.
novice: I [Act] Grapple. Pin [Str←Str].
adept: II [Act] Pin -> 2 penetrating dmg/turn. Expel [Res←Strong].
master: III [Act] Pin -> 3 penetrating dmg/turn (Heals creature).

name: Blood Bond
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Share Corruption with familiar. -1D4 Perm. Corr for mystic, +1D6 Perm. Corr for familiar. 1 XP cost. Risk abomination attack.

name: Borrow Beast
novice: [Spec] Possess small beast (24h). Body in trance. Damage returns mind to body. Witch Circle extends duration indefinitely.

name: Break Link
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Break mystical links (Clairvoyance, Summoning, etc.) or bond to artifact. Negates prior visits for remote viewing.

name: Clairvoyance
novice: [Spec] Observe known location. Targets with Witchsight detect on [Res←Dis]. Blocked by Sanctum/Witch Circle.

name: Command Confession
novice: [Spec] Force victim to answer yes/no questions. Test [Res←Res] per question. Ritual ends on failure.

name: Desecrating Rite
novice: [Spec] Taint site/weapon. Remote viewing site gives 1D6 Temp + Perm Corr. Abominations heal 1D4/hour here. Weapon enables Revenant Strike.

name: Enslave
novice: [Spec] Carve slave rune. Victim obeys blindly. Reveal with Witchsight. Remove: 1D6 dmg + 1D4 Perm Corr.

name: Exchange Shadow
novice: [Spec] Test [Res←Res]. Swap Shadow with victim for 24h. Requires link (hair/blood). Negated by Break Link.

name: Exorcism
novice: [Spec] Banish possessing spirit. 3 attempts [Res←Res]. Success: Spirit banished. Fail x3: Spirit possesses mystic.

name: False Terrain
novice: [Spec] Create illusion over location. See through with [Res←Res] or touch. Lasts 1 month.

name: Familiar
novice: [Spec] Bind beast. Telepathic link/share senses. Transfer 50% dmg. Mystic takes 1D8 dmg if familiar dies.

name: Flaming Servant
novice: [Spec] Bind fire creature to armor. Acts as bodyguard. If destroyed, armor must be repaired to re-cast.

name: Fortune-Telling
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Ask yes/no question about adventure. Once/adventure or after major event.

name: Heretic's Trail
novice: [Spec] Test [Res] to track known abomination/tainted creature. Water breaks trail. 2nd chance to fail in cities/Davokar.

name: Holy Smoke
novice: [Spec] Test [Cun]. Reveal Corruption level of nearby creatures/objects.

name: Illusion
novice: [Spec] Create false image (moves/speaks). Dissolves on touch. Harmless. Lasts 1 scene/hour.

name: Judging Bonds
novice: [Spec] Light prevents shackled person from using powers/traits requiring [Res]. Lasts 1 month.

name: Magic Circle
novice: [Spec] Create circle for telepathy/teleportation. Communicate with any known circle.

name: Nature's Lullaby
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Sing abomination to sleep (pass unnoticed). Ends on aggression/stop singing.

name: Necromancy
novice: [Spec] Ask dead yes/no questions. Test [Res]. Fail: Risk possession [Res←Res].

name: Oracle
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Ask open question about adventure. Once/adventure.

name: Patron Saint
novice: [Spec] Summon guardian spirit (fallen Templar). Invisible until danger. Protects until destroyed.

name: Possess
novice: [Spec] Test [Res←Res]. Control creature 24h. Requires link. Mystic in trance. Dmg to body ends effect.

name: Purging Fire
novice: [Spec] Burn out Corruption. Take 1D6 dmg/turn. Pass [Res-Dmg] to remove 1 Perm. Corr. 1 XP cost.

name: Quick Growth
novice: [Spec] Grow seed to full plant instantly. Form partially controlled (bridge/gate breaker).

name: Sanctifying Rite
novice: [Spec] Shield location from viewing/tracking. Abominations take 1D4 dmg/turn. Weapon enables Witch Hammer.

name: Sanctum
novice: [Spec] Shield room from viewing/entry. Blocks remote rituals. Excludes others from using Magic Circle inside.

name: Seven-League Stride
novice: [Spec] Teleport self + 1 ally from temporary circle to known Magic Circle.

name: Soul Stone
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Transfer 1D4 Perm. Corr to stone. Capacity: Resolute/2. Explodes if exceeded.

name: Summoning
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Summon creature. Requires link. Creature arrives but isn't controlled.

name: Tale Of Ashes
novice: [Spec] Read ashes to see/hear past events of burnt object.

name: Telepathic Interrogation
novice: [Spec] Touch & Test [Res←Res]. Get yes/no answer from subconscious. Fail detects attempt.

name: Turn Weather
novice: [Spec] Alter local weather (fog/storm/calm). Lasts half day.

name: Witch Circle
novice: [Spec] Create permanent circle. Hidden [Vig←Dis]. Control growth. Bonus to Alchemy/Quick Growth inside.

name: Anoint
novice: [Spec] +10 Temp [Tgh], +1D4 Armor, +1D4 Dmg for scene. Cannot heal. Death tests fail automatically.

name: Atonement
novice: [Spec] Reduce sinner's Perm. Corr by 1D4 after task completed. Cost 1 XP.

name: Beast Companion
novice: [Spec] Familiar resurrects at dawn if killed. Link broken if familiar becomes abomination.

name: Bewitching Landscape
novice: [Spec] Enthrall area [Res←Cun]. Confusion/risk starvation. Break with Persuasive or Anathema.

name: Black Sympathy
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Inflict pain on remote target (link req). Prevents healing. Lasts until broken.

name: Blood Storm
novice: [Spec] Unleash storm. Enemies blinded + 1D4 dmg/turn (ign. Armor). 2nd chance to fail tests. Sustained [Res-Dmg].

name: Burdened By Fate
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Bind target to mission. 2nd chance success on mission, 2nd chance fail otherwise.

name: Carve Rune Tattoo
novice: [Spec] Grant Rune Tattoo ability. Cost 10 XP or Perm. Corr (paid by target or mystic).

name: Death Divination
novice: [Spec] 2nd chance to succeed on Necromancy tests.

name: Death Lord
novice: [Spec] Summon powerful undead (Death Lord). Acts as second character.

name: False Shape
novice: [Spec] Change appearance of self/ally to generic member of race. Lasts 1 week.

name: Faraway Writing
novice: [Spec] Write message/symbol on remote surface. Visible to all or specific person.

name: Fata Morgana
novice: [Spec] Create real terrain/building (half Tgh). Lasts 1 month. Cost 1 XP.

name: Flesh Craft
novice: [Spec] Grant monstrous trait (I) to victim. 1D4 Perm. Corr per trait.

name: Life Extension
novice: [Spec] Postpone aging 1 year. Cost 1 XP or Perm. Corr + Elixir of Life.

name: Living Fortress
novice: [Spec] Create living fort. Pass [Qui←Res] x3 to enter or take 1D12 dmg/fail. Lasts 1 season. Cost 1 XP.

name: Phylactery
novice: [Spec] Bind soul to vessel. Resurrect 1D12 days after death. Cost 1 XP/Corr to create. 1D6 Perm. Corr per resurrection.

name: Piercing Gaze
novice: [Spec] 2nd chance on Holy Smoke. Test [Cun] to see through Exchange Shadow.

name: Quake
novice: [Spec] Slam staff. 1D6 Temp. Corr. Knockdown nearby [Res←Qui] (1D4 dmg). Or Razing dmg to structures.

name: Raise Undead
novice: [Spec] Test [Res←Res]. Raise corpse as undead servant. Decay reduces [Str] yearly.

name: Restore
novice: [Spec] Sing to mend broken item.

name: Retrieve
novice: [Spec] Sing to find lost object. [Res←Dis] if hidden.

name: Rune Guardian
novice: [Spec] Create guardian from statue. Acts as second character. Loses XP on death.

name: Sealing/Opening Rite
novice: [Spec] Seal door (no test) or Open door [Res←Difficulty].

name: Servant Daemon
novice: [Spec] Bind servant daemon. Acts as second character.

name: Soul Trap
novice: [Spec] Test [Res]. Trap newly dead soul in vessel.

name: Spell Trap
novice: [Spec] Bind power to location/object with trigger.

name: Spell Tunnel
novice: [Spec] Open tunnel to observed location. Cast powers through tunnel.

name: Summon Daemon
novice: [Spec] Summon daemon. Control [Res←Res] (bonus for sacrifice). Unbound stays 24h. 1 XP cost.

name: Torment
novice: [Spec] Curse victim (link req). Wither (-1 Tgh/week) or annoy. Prevent healing.

name: Traceless
novice: [Spec] Erase physical traces for 24h (past or future).

name: Twin Servants
novice: [Spec] Maintain two Flaming Servants.

name: Flexible
novice: [Pas] Armor/Shield is less impeding. Light: 0 penalty. Med: -1. Heavy: -2.

name: Balanced
novice: [Pas] +1 Defense.

name: Blunt
novice: [Pas] Weapon deals 1 step lower dmg (e.g., Staff 1D6).

name: Cumbersome
novice: [Pas] High Defense penalty (Light -3, Med -4, Heavy -5).

name: Deep impact
novice: [Pas] Deal +1 damage.

name: Impeding
novice: [Pas] Penalty to Def/Sneak/Powers (Light -2, Med -3, Heavy -4).

name: Jointed
novice: [Pas] Ignore parry on odd die roll (deals 1D6 dmg).

name: Long
novice: [Pas] Free Attack vs enemies entering melee (unless they have Long).

name: Precise
novice: [Pas] +1 to Attack tests.

name: Short
